streams.name: Tailliuir Studio
streams.title: ① Install Tailliuir Network to connect
streams.description: You need the Tailliuir Network addon installed first — that's what actually connects you to the Tailliuir Studio network. This addon on its own is just information.

streams.name: Tailliuir Studio
streams.title: ② Know your traffic lights
streams.description: 🟢 Green = best link, use first · 🟠 Orange = okay, solid backup · 🔴 Red = avoid, or last resort only. This only applies to the Tailliuir Network addon.

streams.name: Tailliuir Studio
streams.title: ③ Check TorBox status if something's off
streams.description: Before assuming it's broken, check status.torbox.app — most issues are a TorBox outage or maintenance window, not your setup.

streams.name: Tailliuir Studio
streams.title: ④ Full install links & spares — tap the gear icon
streams.description: For install links, backup addons, and everything else, open the settings wheel on this addon to reach the full Tailliuir Studio site.

streams.name: Tailliuir Studio
